description: The Athena companion window (ADR 0026). It holds exactly one webview and that webview is privileged, so, unlike `ui.json` whose window also holds page webviews, it may name its window. What it is granted is what her stores need and nothing of Main's: her own window commands, the tab list and the bridge (the run loop runs a page's tools on the focused tab), the daemon's status, the store, and the hands. It is given no tabs_create, tabs_close, tabs_focus, tabs_navigate or layout_*: she reads what Main has open and never opens, closes or selects anything in it.
